title: ageratina intercostulata
intro: Ageratina intercostulata, commonly known as Tree Aster, is a plant species belonging to the mint family Lamiaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Mexico and Central America, due to its reported health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Ageratina intercostulata include reducing fever, relieving pain and inflammation, and acting as a diuretic, making it useful for treating conditions such as arthritis and urinary issues. The plant contains bioactive constituents like sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
